articles: Every account has a max loss floor. On evaluations it trails your highest end-of-day balance by the max loss for your size ($1,000 on 25K, $2,000 on 50K, $3,000 on 100K, $4,500 on 150K). It only moves at the end of the trading day, never down. On funded accounts it stops $100 above your starting balance. If your balance touches the floor at any time, the account is breached.

If you lose more than your daily loss limit in one trading day ($500 on 25K, $1,000 on 50K, $2,000 on 100K, $3,000 on 150K), trading pauses until the next session opens at 6:00 PM ET. The account is not closed. The trading day runs from 6:00 PM to 5:00 PM ET.
You cannot open new orders from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after a high-impact event on the news calendar. Positions you already hold can stay open. The calendar is on the Resources page.

To pass an evaluation, your best day can be at most 50% of your total profit. For a funded payout, your best day in the cycle can be at most 40% of that cycle's profit (20% on Instant accounts). If one big day breaks the rule, keep trading: more profitable days bring the share down.
How and When You Get Paid

Funded accounts can request a payout after 5 winning days of $100 or more in the cycle, with at least $250 available. You keep 90% (Instant: 80% for the first 3 payouts, then 90%). Each payout has a cap by size, and there is a lifetime cap per account. Requests are reviewed in 1 to 2 business days, then sent by Rise or USDC.
Rise pays you in your local currency by bank transfer. Add your bank account under Settings, Payout Methods. New payout methods are held for 48 hours as a safety check.

Platform connections are being set up. Until they go live, your accounts trade on the Funded Sky simulated feed and your dashboard shows every trade. We will email your platform login when your connection is ready.
You can switch platform once per account, before your first trade. Contact support with your account number and the platform you want.

Evaluations with no trades can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Resets, activation fees and accounts that have traded cannot be refunded. Refunds go back to your original payment method in 3 to 5 business days.
Resets: What Happens to Your Account

A reset puts your evaluation back to its starting balance with the same rules. Your trading days, best day and history start over. A reset costs 55% of the plan price. If you bought the Free Reset add-on, your first reset is free.

Before your first payout we verify your identity once. You need a passport, driver's license or national ID, and your name must match your payout method. Submit your details under Settings, Identity. Our team reviews them within 1 business day.
